description: wigolo test/run environment: Node 22 (matches CI) plus the runtime libraries Playwright's bundled Chromium needs on NixOS, which has no /usr/lib.

init_hook: # NixOS has no /usr/lib, so Playwright's bundled Chromium cannot find its
# runtime libraries. devbox's own package farm drops glib's and dbus's
# /lib — the two it needs most — so the set comes from a buildEnv in
# devbox.d/playwright-libs. Guarded: the flake only defines x86_64-linux,
# and pointing LD_LIBRARY_PATH at it elsewhere would poison every child.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-native.mjs || npm rebuild better-sqlite3; npm run build && npx vitest run
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/check-native.mjs || npm rebuild better-sqlite3; npx vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/check-native.mjs || npm rebuild better-sqlite3; npm run build && npx vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/check-native.mjs || npm rebuild better-sqlite3; npm run build && npx vitest run tests/e2e
